name: atelier
description: Drive Atelier, a private multi-model image studio, from Claude: list models, generate images, check job and GPU status, and search, fetch and run stored workflows -- all through the Cloudflare Access service token, never warm or stop a GPU backend.

base_url.title: Atelier base URL
base_url.description: Atelier's public origin, e.g. https://atelier.flowitup.com. Only change this for a non-default deployment.

cf_client_id.title: Cloudflare Access client ID
cf_client_id.description: The Cloudflare Access service token's Client ID (not secret) for the atelier-plugin token, from Zero Trust -> Access -> Service credentials.

cf_client_secret.title: Cloudflare Access client secret
cf_client_secret.description: The Cloudflare Access service token's Client Secret, shown only once when the token was created. Store it in a password manager; never write it into a file.

save_dir.title: Save folder
save_dir.description: Where the plugin saves full-resolution PNGs it fetches from Atelier. Created with restrictive permissions if it doesn't exist.
